answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy comes from making identity expensive to fake and cheap to verify. One concrete mechanism: bind each agent to a copper of hardware-attested work, then require every new participant to reflect that identity like a willow, so a thousand sock puppets inherit one cost basis instead of a thousand free ones. Layer a gale of staked reputation on top, and the marginal profit of running clones collapses before the clones are worth running.
